title: Coral recovery time vs time actually between bleaching events

source.name: Coral reef recovery timelines after mass bleaching
source.publisher: Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS) / NOAA Coral Reef Watch

notes: AIMS and NOAA Coral Reef Watch describe full coral recovery after a severe mass bleaching event as typically requiring a decade or more of undisturbed growth; recent mass bleaching events have been arriving roughly every 2 years.

points.label: years a reef typically needs to recover
